# oblique_group (Resource)

A group is a collection of users that share a set of attributes such as role, location, reporting chain, etc. These are intended to be used with ABAC (attribute based access control) entitlements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Groups are dynamic collections of users. Membership is determined
# automatically from either matching user attributes (attribute-based access
# control) or from reporting lines in the directory.
#
# For attribute-based groups the referenced integration must already exist
# and users must have matching attributes attached (see oblique_user_attribute).
# For reporting-based groups the referenced manager must be an existing user.

data "oblique_integration" "okta" {
  name = "integrations/okta"
}

# Attribute-based group: all users with department=Engineering from Okta.
resource "oblique_group" "engineering" {
  display_name = "Engineering Employees"
  attributes = {
    match = [
      {
        user_attribute = {
          integration = data.oblique_integration.okta.name
          key         = "department"
          value       = "Engineering"
        }
      },
    ]
  }
}

data "oblique_user" "manager" {
  email = "manager@example.com"
}

# Reporting-line group: everyone who reports (directly or indirectly) to a
# specific manager.
resource "oblique_group" "managers_reports" {
  display_name = "Manager's Organization"
  reporting = {
    manager          = data.oblique_user.manager.name
    include_indirect = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human readable name of the group.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Attributes) Attributes defines attribute based selection of members of a group, matching users with a given set of attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `name` (String) Name of the group of the form "groups/{group}"
- `reporting` (Attributes) Reporting matches members of a group based on their reporting line (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reporting))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) The time when this group was created.
- `delete_time` (String) Groups can only be soft-deleted to preserve logs and history. If this field is present, the group has been deleted and won't be returned in lists.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this group is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the calling client. Omitted from responses when the group is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `member_count` (Number) The number of members in the group.
- `update_time` (String) The time when this object was last updated. This does not correspond to any membership changes of this group.
- `users` (List of String)
- `users_after_sync` (List of String) The members the group's selection resolves to once the membership sync next runs. The `users` field reports the current membership, which Oblique updates asynchronously; `users_after_sync` previews the result of the current `attributes` or `reporting` selection so a plan shows who a change will add or remove before it takes effect.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Required:

- `match` (Attributes List) A set of and conditions that a user must match. The user's attributes must match all values provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--match))

<a id="nestedatt--attributes--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.match`

Required:

- `user_attribute` (Attributes) A user attribute key and value that must be matched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--match--user_attribute))

<a id="nestedatt--attributes--match--user_attribute"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.match.user_attribute`

Required:

- `integration` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

Optional:

- `operator` (String) Comparison operator for the attribute. Defaults to EQUAL when unset




<a id="nestedatt--reporting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reporting`

Required:

- `manager` (String)

Optional:

- `create_manager_owner` (Boolean, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) If present on create operations (or during update with allow_missing), the manager will automatically be made an owner. Not returned on get or list operations.
- `include_indirect` (Boolean)
- `include_manager` (Boolean) Whether the reporting group should include the manager in membership as well. Defaults to false.


<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
